coverage.main_ink_policy: All visible major bottom-row ink is addressed by row spans, whole bodies, or detached mark hypotheses, including the long rising terminal at lower right. This is an approximate visual coverage map, not a pixel mask completeness certificate.
coverage.row_reading_order: R2 through R6 spatial top-to-bottom, within each row increasing native x; order does not imply cipher text sequence.
coverage.span_granularity: Many records intentionally cover several close local bodies. Explicit local partitions remain unresolved; the record count is not a sign count.
coverage.firstband_uncovered_residuals: Detached first-band boundary marks listed separately; any same-occurrence relation to immutable U records remains unchosen.
coverage.tiny_flecks: Not every halftone dot or faint paper fleck has an individual bbox; nonmanual texture is inventoried by region.
